text:
nova: quick thread - we need a minimal ship for observability next sprint. customers asking: per-model cost, error slices, trace hook, sampling.

ben: agreed. propose a tiny MVP: emit per-token counters, add span tag for model, simple errors table. UI lightweight.

olga: can runtime emit model.variant tag without perf hit? estimate 1 dev-day.

michael: SRE: yes but retention defaults must be conservative. recommend 24h for free tier, 90d for enterprise opt-in.

tara: CS: two customers need per-model cost; they'll accept token counts first if we explain infra calc is coming.

pm-bot: ticket created: PROD-8543 "obs: token counters + model-span + errors table (MVP)" assigned to ben/olga.

nova: acceptance checks (MVP):
- metrics: token counters per model+route available in metrics backend for 7d
- traces: span with model.name and model.variant emitted (no prompt text)
- ui: simple table showing token counts and top error messages per route
- sampling: global sampling control on console (off/10/100)

ben: fallback plan: if cost calc not ready, show token counts only and link to billing after next sprint. if traces too big, disable detailed tags by default.

olga: privacy note: strip prompt content from spans and never store prompts as tags.

michael: I'll add runbook entry and alert gating for new trace volume.

nova: ok team. ship plan: week1 runtime + metrics, week2 table UI + sampling toggle. tara will send customer note. reconvene Thu standup to lock timeline.

tara: will draft customer comms today. thanks. :white_check_mark:
